_readme: Single source for project, writing, photo and 'currently' content. Edit here, then run `npm run content` to rewrite the marked regions in the HTML pages. Only verified facts: every claim below is traceable to a repo README, a case study on this site, or the pre-redesign homepage copy.

person.name: Maria Showalter
person.line: I build interactive software that behaves like material — springs you can tune, cloth you can play, prints that develop — and the tools that turn it into something people can use.
person.study: Computer Science, Barnard College of Columbia University · Hellenic Studies minor · Class of 2028

projects.name: FrameFlow
projects.statement: Turns a raw macOS screen recording into a composed product film: clicks and pauses become editable camera Moments, and one renderer drives preview, MP4 and GIF.
projects.medium: macOS app · Electron · React · Swift (ScreenCaptureKit) · WebCodecs

media.alt: FrameFlow studio: a recorded demo page on the canvas with its camera Moments on the timeline

projects.name: Hinge
projects.statement: Tune hover, press and drag by handling a component and shaping its spring, then export a React component that moves exactly the way it did on the stage.
projects.medium: Web app · React · TypeScript · closed-form spring solver · code generation

media.alt: Hinge editor: a card on the stage beside its drag-and-release spring curve
media.note: Capture from before Hinge's current redesign

projects.name: Iris
projects.statement: Three browser studies in digital tactility: a slime you pull, a fabric you play as an instrument, and a darkroom where prints develop under your hand.
projects.medium: Series · three.js · TypeScript · Web Audio · custom simulation
projects.role: Design and engineering · builds on Holocloth by Dmitry Kurash (MIT)

media.alt: Iris Resonance: a translucent violet membrane rippling on a dark blue ground

projects.name: Edition
projects.statement: A photograph becomes a two-ink print: editable halftone plates set at their own angles, overprinted on paper and deliberately out of register, exported at full resolution.
projects.medium: Web app · TypeScript · image processing · Web Workers
projects.status: Live · runs entirely in the browser · MIT

media.alt: Edition loupe view: cobalt and coral halftone dots overprinting on paper
media.note: Capture from before Edition's current redesign

projects.name: Orbit
projects.statement: Choreograph sounds around a listener on a top-down stage. Positions drive real HRTF panning, and the arrangement renders to a WAV that pans the way playback did.
projects.medium: Web app · Web Audio (PannerNode, OfflineAudioContext) · TypeScript

media.alt: Orbit soundstage: three voices around a listener, one following a drawn figure-eight
media.note: Capture from before Orbit's current redesign

projects.name: Filo
projects.statement: A campus map of places ranked by people you trust: rank by comparison in about log₂(n) taps, find your taste twins, with privacy enforced in the database.
projects.medium: Mobile app (prototype) · React Native / Expo · Supabase (Postgres, RLS) · Mapbox

media.alt: Diagram: a new place is compared against the midpoint of a ranked list, halving the list each tap

otherWork.name: TONUS
otherWork.statement: Polyphonic web synthesizer: FM, AM, additive and subtractive synthesis crossfaded in real time, with a chord generator, scope and recorder.

otherWork.name: Global Plastics Recycling Dashboard
otherWork.statement: AI automation pipeline that keeps a recycling-facility dashboard current from press releases and live feeds; presented at ACC's 2025 Geneva conference.
otherWork.medium: Python · n8n · Excel · American Chemistry Council, summer 2025

otherWork.name: Filo recommendation engine
otherWork.statement: Semantic search over a synthetic NYC venue catalogue with a MiniLM model fine-tuned by contrastive loss; not connected to the app.

otherWork.name: REINFORCE from scratch
otherWork.statement: A two-joint arm learns to reach with a policy-gradient loop written by hand — no RL libraries — with a browser visualiser of training.

otherWork.name: Inverted pendulum PID
otherWork.statement: Cart-pole physics and a PID controller written from scratch, with a dashboard for tuning Kp, Ki and Kd while it runs.

otherWork.name: Stencil
otherWork.statement: Team hackathon project, 1st place at the NYU EEG Hackathon: a handle becomes a full brand identity, assets and a printable guide.

otherWork.name: Sheet Music to Strudel
otherWork.statement: Sheet music, MusicXML and MIDI to live-coded Strudel patterns through a staged pipeline with validation.

otherWork.name: SafeScan
otherWork.statement: Team of four: QR and URL scanner combining Google Safe Browsing with an 11-rule heuristic engine for typosquatting and phishing.

playground.name: Soft Matter
playground.line: A slime you can pull, poke and squish — a skin that accepts a stretch, then forgets it.
playground.alt: Soft Matter: a butter-yellow block stretched by a pointer

playground.name: Resonance
playground.line: A fabric you play as an instrument; the ripples are a damped wave equation and the sound comes from the same physics.
playground.alt: Resonance: a violet membrane stretched into a ridge

playground.name: Afterimage
playground.line: A darkroom where prints develop; dodging and burning edit a map of exposure time.
playground.alt: Afterimage: a print developing under red safelight while being dodged

playground.name: TONUS
playground.line: A polyphonic synthesizer you play from the keyboard; four synthesis methods crossfaded live.

playground.name: DJ deck
playground.line: Two decks, filters and an equal-power crossfader, on this site.
